# WordPress MCP Adapter

`GRADED` `WRITES-DIRECT`

The official WordPress package that exposes a site's registered abilities as MCP tools. WooCommerce for Claude builds on the same layer; what it can do depends entirely on which abilities a site makes public.

| Type | MCP server — tools Claude can call |

## Why these badges

- **`WRITES-DIRECT`** — Executes whatever abilities a site registers and marks public, with per-ability permission checks but no built-in confirmation step. Abilities are private by default, so nothing is exposed until the site owner opts in.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a WordPress site with abilities registered and marked public` | **yes** | site plugins | none — no tools are exposed |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| tool results | chat | the MCP client |

## What it will not do

- Expose an ability the site has not marked public.

## Data reachability

| System | Status | Auth | Settlement data |
|---|---|---|---|
| `woocommerce` | **costly** — Reachable only at material cost | `merchant-keys` | partial |

- `woocommerce` — No registration exists and no revocation signal. Per-merchant key entry.
